name: Kurayoshi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kurayoshi city emblem in red: an outlined ring crossed by horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kurayoshi, a city in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 29 March 1954.

features.role: Kurayoshi city emblem — an outlined ring crossed by horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character
